morphology.pattern_note: 英语虚构角色专名，整词记忆；不按马来语拆分词尾 -ers 或 -s。IPA 为英式英语参考读音，并非 DBP 核定的马来语读音。

senses.zh_definition: 斑斑：英国《哈利·波特》系列中罗恩·韦斯莱所养宠物鼠的名字。
senses.en_definition: The name of Ron Weasley’s pet rat in the Harry Potter series.
senses.ms_definition: Nama tikus peliharaan Ron Weasley dalam siri Harry Potter.
senses.nuances: 属文学专名，正常书写为 Scabbers，不能用作马来语“老鼠”的普通名称。未确认其为 DBP 词条，马来文释义为本条编写。以下为角色讨论中的示范组合，不代表经统计确认的高频搭配。[《哈利·波特》官方百科：Scabbers](https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/characters-and-pets/scabbers)

etymology.historical_story: Scabbers is a fictional pet name from the Harry Potter stories. The official character guide associates the name with the rat’s patchy fur and describes his fondness for sleeping. Readers may connect its sound with English scab or scabby, but that association should not be presented as a documented account of the author’s naming process. [Official character guide](https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/characters-and-pets/scabbers)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 scab（痂）联想毛皮斑驳的宠物鼠，再记中文名“斑斑”；这是记忆联想，不是马来语构词。
